poin.isi: Meta launched Muse for Small Business (September 29). The agent connects to tools businesses already use: Shopify, QuickBooks (Intuit), Canva, Figma, Slack, Zoom, Asana, Box and Dropbox — plus Meta ad accounts and professional Instagram/Facebook profiles.
Meta says the agent will not post, send messages or buy anything without the owner's approval. The value of an agent comes from access; the risk is managed by permissions.
Choose an agent with clear limits: what it may do on its own, and what must go through your approval. Start with small tasks, review the results, then expand.

headline: AN AI AGENT IN YOUR BUSINESS
BUT NEVER WITHOUT PERMISSION
headline_caption: Meta: the agent does not post, message or buy without the owner's approval.
subjudul: Meta releases Muse for Small Business — an agent wired into your store, books and ads, that always asks the owner first.
